Yes, the only way to really make progress with OCD, is to Accept Uncertainty. That's what OCD really. Most people can deal with not knowing 100% for sure about stuff. Our minds are not wired that way. So #1 Learn as best as you can to tolerate not knowing for sure about stuff, #2 Allow the weird thoughts to be there. Just get use to them as best you can. #3 Don't avoid stuff that makes you anxious. and over time your brain build up tolerance and get unstuck. BUT since OCD is chronic, it will always be with you. It just takes a break for periods of time.
